title: Native cron / scheduled recurring jobs with timezone support?

posts.author: planner_pat
posts.body: Does Corvex have built-in recurring/cron jobs — 'run ReportJob every weekday at 09:00 America/New_York'? I only see one-off `enqueue` and delayed enqueue (`--in 5m`).

posts.author: nadia_corvex
posts.body: Not in 2.6. Corvex has one-off enqueue and delayed enqueue (`--in <duration>` / `--at <timestamp>`), but there is no native cron scheduler and no timezone-aware recurrence. People currently drive recurring work from an external scheduler (system cron, k8s CronJob, etc.) that calls `corvex enqueue`. A native periodic scheduler is on the roadmap but not committed to a release, and there's no timezone handling design yet.
